text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)AS AMENDED BY LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT No. 28 OF 1964 Notice Under Section 7 My Reference No.: KEG /LAN/AQUIS/A3/1/96. Land Min. No. : 4/3/5/2014/HW/64. I hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment Act), No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the additional land lots described in the schedule given below for construction of phase 111 of Alternative Highway, Kegalle Description of the land to be acquired: One (01) allotment of land attached below depicted in Preliminary Plan No. 3666 prepared by Surveyor General, Kegalle situated in 51E Golahela Town limits Grama Niladhari Division of Kegalle Divisional Secretary’s Division in Kegalle District of Sabaragamuwa Province. Dates of Inquries in P.P. K. 3666 Lot No. 01; 21.03.2019 from 10.00 a. m.
Acquisition of Land lots for construction of Kegalle Alternative Highway

Schedule Plan No. P. P. K. 3666 Lot No. 01 — Name of the Land: No. 252, Bandaranayake Mawatha, Kegalle; Name and Address of Claimant: C. N. C. Manathunga, No. 252, Bandaranayake Mawatha, Kegalla; Extent: 0.0140 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid lands to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Kegalle on the above mentioned date and on the scheduled time. And are hereby requested to notify to me in writing with duplicate of on or before 07th of March 2019 the nature of their interest in the land the particulars of their claims for compensation, for acquisition of the said land, and the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
K. G. S. NISHANTHA, Divisional Secretary, Land Acquisition Officer, Kegalle.
